# ABOUT YOUR SECURITY PROVIDER [italic]Professional. Discreet. On contract.[/italic]
## WHO WE ARE The colonial government has contracted Weyland-Yutani, through its subsidiary Whiteguard Solutions, to provide security at {colony}. The personnel you see are Company PMC operators, informally the Whiteshields: veterans with modern equipment, thorough training and a clear statement of work. Governments hire us because we deliver faster and more reliably than the alternatives. We intend to prove that again here.
## OPERATIONAL STRUCTURE - [bold]PMC Operations Director:[/bold] sets the site alert level, the curfew and the access tiers, and authorises every notice on this board. - [bold]PMC Operations Adjutant:[/bold] manages daily operations and handles client and resident feedback. - [bold]Operations staff:[/bold] patrol rosters, checkpoint protocols, logistics, and liaison with Colony Administration. - [bold]Operators and team leads:[/bold] the security professionals you will meet on site.
## STATEMENT OF WORK Under the colonial security contract, the provider will: - protect residents, staff and property from hostile action, including insurgent cells using the Colonial Liberation Front name; - provide emergency response to fire, structural failure, gas release and mass casualty events; - monitor atmospheric and perimeter conditions and issue early warnings; - secure power, water, atmosphere processing and landing facilities, which are critical assets.
## LESSONS LEARNED In 2168 Drill Site 68-B on Albacetire breached a pocket of pressurised carbon monoxide. More than twelve thousand people were lost in the Carbon Ravine disaster. The industry learned an expensive lesson: an unmonitored hazard is an uninsured liability. Every Whiteshield is also a trained first responder, and every gas monitor on this site is on our maintenance schedule.
## SERVICE STANDARDS - Operators will identify themselves by operator number on request. - Property is only removed against a numbered receipt. Claims are processed by the Adjutant. - Force is applied in proportion to the threat, and every use is documented. - Operational matters are confidential. Operators will not discuss them, and we ask that you do not either.
